definition: Combinations of people or things considered unsuitable together.
author: Jane Austen
quote: But, fair or not fair, there are unbecoming conjunctions, which reason will patronize in vain—which taste cannot tolerate—which ridicule will seize.
example_sentence: Some flavour conjunctions, like mint and orange juice, should never be attempted.
